# Third-party native software

With `build_from_source`, this package downloads the native projects below.
Their source is not included in the published Rust package. The listed
revisions are the revisions selected by the default pinned TBLIS source tree.
Redistributors of linked binaries must retain the applicable notices and
license terms. Copies of the corresponding upstream license files are
included under `licenses/`.

| TCI | <https://github.com/MatthewsResearchGroup/tci> | `c51c0cde35aa5a88d15793300257234a5ca886cb` | [`licenses/TCI`](licenses/TCI) |
